# SquareRootShield — trial division only needs small wheels

**Status:** proved in Lean

A number is prime exactly when no prime at or below the square root of the ceiling divides it.

## Claims

<a id="square_root_shield"></a>
### `square_root_shield`

Below a ceiling, a number is prime exactly when no smaller prime at or below the square root of the ceiling divides it.

```lean
/-- **The square-root shield.** For every ceiling and every number from 2 up
to that ceiling: the number is prime exactly when it has no prime factor
that is smaller than itself and at most the (whole-number) square root of
the ceiling. -/
def square_root_shield : Prop :=
  ∀ X x : Nat, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ X →
    (x.Prime ↔ ¬ ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ x ∧ p < x ∧ p ≤ Nat.sqrt X)
```
